products.name: Avoma
products.note: Meeting intelligence AI; conversation analytics; coaching; revenue team data

profile_text.body:
Avoma is a software company headquartered in Fremont, California, that offers what it describes as an all-in-one AI platform covering note-taking, scheduling, and coaching. The platform is aimed at revenue and sales teams and is designed to automate tasks such as meeting note-taking, email follow-ups, CRM data entry, lead qualification, and call scoring. The company describes its model as pay-only-for-what-you-need and claims users can save four or more hours per week through its automations.

The site's tracked product, also called Avoma, falls in the notes, knowledge, and meetings category and encompasses meeting intelligence, conversation analytics, coaching tools, and revenue team data. Specific capabilities include an AI Copilot for answering questions from call content, personalized call coaching, talk-pattern and topic-trend visibility, pipeline inspection, and AI-driven win-loss analysis intended to support sales forecasting and quota attainment.

The held facts show Avoma has a verified presence in the site's registry as of August 2026 and carries a notable law-exposure count of 139 entries associated with California, though no specific litigation cases are recorded in the available data.
